summary: LF-1 v1.2 Iterations 2/3/4 FRONTEND E2E validation for Letters & Follow-ups. Backend was previously green (iter_64: 54/54). This run exercises all 6 archetype intake forms + safeguarding + response-draft flows on the live preview URL as cathy@example.com. Every requested testid renders and the LLM generate + feedback + share + delete flows all work end-to-end. Two live Claude Sonnet 4.5 generation runs succeeded (request archetype for situation 1, complaint archetype for situation 4) and produced well-structured letters citing Aged Care Act 2024 Schedule 1 Statement of Rights. Cross-tool import chips populate for Cathy (Price check · Personal care · TEST_UI_Bright at $105 + Contribution estimate · full · Class 4). MAC portal short-form + PDF + email format switcher work. Feedback thumbs-up persists across page reload. ADM modal opens. Safeguarding gate (situation 11) correctly transitions to guided-pathway detail page with structured safeguarding record UI. Share panel renders Cathy as household member (user_id-based testid works). Evidence upload attaches files, per-file note autosaves, remove works. Soft delete + navigation to log works. Correspondence log loads.

issues: The 'Tone check is temporarily disabled.' message (rendered when feature flag lf1_tone_check is off) has no data-testid — the spec called out `lf1-tone-check-disabled` for automated detection but the DOM emits an untagged `<div className='text-xs text-muted-k italic'>`. Cosmetic — the message is visible to users and behaves correctly.

Console emits `Warning: Missing 'Description' or 'aria-describedby={undefined}' for {DialogContent}` for both the lf1-adm-modal and lf1-detail-delete-modal. Accessibility polish — Radix DialogContent needs a DialogDescription or aria-describedby set.

verified_features.evidence: lf1-situation-grid renders; click lf1-situation-1 → nav to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/{id}; lf1-intake-form + lf1-adm-link visible
lf1-intake-change-type-select, lf1-intake-change-summary-input, lf1-intake-participant-input, lf1-evidence-attach, lf1-intake-notes all render
lf1-intake-dispute-type-select, lf1-intake-ref-input, lf1-intake-dispute-summary-input all render
lf1-intake-complaint-category-select, lf1-intake-complaint-summary-input, lf1-intake-prior-response-input + lf1-complaint-mode-{open,confidential,anonymous} all render
lf1-intake-escalation-summary-input, lf1-prior-add clickable; after click lf1-prior-date-0, lf1-prior-recipient-0, lf1-prior-summary-0, lf1-prior-remove-0 all render
lf1-intake-notification-type-select, lf1-intake-effective-date-input, lf1-intake-notification-summary-input render

Clicking lf1-situation-11 opens lf1-safeguarding-gate modal; lf1-safeguarding-letter → lf1-safeguarding-proceed navigates to detail page with archetype=guided_pathway; lf1-intake-safeguarding-{category-select, observation-input, calls-input} + lf1-safeguarding-generate + lf1-detail-guided-record all render
lf1-intake-inbound-from-input, lf1-intake-stance-select, lf1-intake-inbound-summary-input, lf1-intake-response-points-input, lf1-response-draft-generate render
For Cathy: lf1-cross-tool-panel renders with Price check + Contribution estimate chips; verified panel appears (after brief signals loading state)
Typing in lf1-intake-participant-input triggers PATCH /api/lf1/correspondence/:id/autosave and lf1-detail-autosave-hint chip appears within ~1.8s
With only participant name filled, clicking lf1-generate-button returns 422; lf1-missing-fields renders 'Change Summary' as the missing field

After filling change_summary, generate returns 200 with subject + body. lf1-generated-output, lf1-cover-note, lf1-output-formats, lf1-generated-subject, lf1-generated-body all render. Body cites Aged Care Act 2024 Schedule 1 rights.
Complaint on 3 missed shower visits generated a fully-structured complaint letter citing Schedule 1 item 1 with a 14-day response window and specific asks
Clicking lf1-format-mac-portal renders lf1-generated-portal
Clicking lf1-feedback-up posts to /api/lf1/correspondence/:id/feedback; lf1-feedback-saved chip appears; after page reload the chip is still there
Clicking lf1-adm-link opens lf1-adm-modal Dialog

lf1-tone-check-run button visible; clicking it posts to /api/lf1/correspondence/:id/tone-check; because lf1_tone_check flag is disabled the response is {enabled:false} and the UI renders 'Tone check is temporarily disabled.'

lf1-share-panel renders; Cathy (fbaf9ceb-9be3-4c9b-b1d6-bcfe4e13d852) is listed as household member checkbox lf1-share-member-{uuid}; lf1-share-require-signoff + lf1-share-submit render (submit disabled until at least one member selected)

verified_features.feature: Guided pathway share panel gated off
verified_features.evidence: For archetype=guided_pathway, lf1-share-panel is intentionally NOT rendered (matches !isGuidedPathway guard in CorrespondenceDetail.jsx). Correct behaviour.

Setting a file on lf1-evidence-file-input adds a chip in lf1-evidence-list; lf1-evidence-note-{filename} accepts note and triggers autosave (lf1-detail-autosave-hint fires); lf1-evidence-remove-{filename} removes the chip
lf1-detail-delete opens lf1-detail-delete-modal; lf1-detail-delete-confirm soft-deletes entry and navigates to /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/log
lf1-log-title renders; entries list populates

For Cathy at this point in time GET /api/lf1/follow-ups returns empty overdue/upcoming lists so lf1-follow-up-panel is not rendered — data-dependent behaviour; the code has correct conditional rendering. Escalate button (lf1-followup-escalate-{id}) was not exercisable because there are no overdue rows to escalate.

action_items: LOW / cosmetic — Add `data-testid="lf1-tone-check-disabled"` to the italic text 'Tone check is temporarily disabled.' in LetterGeneration.jsx line ~1067. Enables reliable automated detection of the feature-flag-off branch and matches the testid the spec called out.

LOW / a11y — Two Radix DialogContent instances (lf1-adm-modal, lf1-detail-delete-modal) emit `Warning: Missing 'Description' or 'aria-describedby'` in the console. Add a <DialogDescription> child or aria-describedby prop to silence the warning and improve screen-reader UX.

OPTIONAL — To exercise lf1-follow-up-panel + lf1-followup-escalate-{id} in the log page, either seed a correspondence entry with next_action_due_at set to a past date, or run the current smoke against a household that has already sent a letter and hit its response window. Not blocking for this iteration.

OPTIONAL — CrossToolImportPanel renders a plain 'Checking your other tools…' loader with no data-testid during the initial GET /lf1/cross-tool-signals in-flight window (~500ms-2s). Adding `data-testid="lf1-cross-tool-loading"` would let tests wait deterministically on the panel resolving instead of using a magic sleep.
critical_code_review_comments: LetterGeneration.jsx is 1399 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold in your guidelines. Consider splitting the 6 archetype forms into their own module (e.g. /components/lf1/intake-forms/*.jsx) and pulling ShareAndSignOffPanel + ToneCheckPanel out into siblings. Nothing broken, just maintainability.

CorrespondenceDetail.jsx autosave effect (line 90) still fires on the very first user keystroke even though line 74 seeds the intake state from the loaded entry. The `dirty` guard added since iter_1 correctly prevents the noisy initial empty save — nice fix from prior feedback.

ShareAndSignOffPanel loads /household/members on every mount without caching. Fine for now but the same call likely runs on 6+ pages (Family Coordinator, Reassessment, PPC, LF-1) — a lightweight react-query cache or module-level singleton would eliminate the redundant round-trips.

The tone-check 'disabled' branch (LetterGeneration.jsx L1066-1068) sets result={disabled:true} but the branch renders no testid. Add `data-testid="lf1-tone-check-disabled"` for the italic <div>. Same file line 1067.

Evidence-upload testids use the raw filename (e.g. `lf1-evidence-remove-my file with spaces.pdf`). Two files with identical names will collide. Non-critical but consider using the internal `it.id` (which already includes size + timestamp) instead.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested testid + flow verified E2E

test_credentials: cathy@example.com / testpass123 (family plan, Dorothy household). No solo/trial or admin exercise needed for this feature.
seed_data_creation: Test created ~4 correspondence entries under cathy@example.com during this run (one per archetype exercised). One was hard-tested through the soft-delete flow; the others remain in her correspondence log as drafts. Two live LLM generations were made (~$0.02 in Claude Sonnet 4.5 token cost).
context_for_next_testing_agent: LF-1 v1.2 Iter 2/3/4 frontend is stable and shippable. If you need to test the follow-up panel + escalate button (data-dependent path not exercised here), seed a correspondence entry via `db.lf1_correspondence.updateOne({user_id:<cathy_id>, status:'sent'}, {$set:{next_action_due_at: new Date(Date.now()-14*86400000)}})` before loading /tools/letters-and-follow-ups/log. To exercise the tone-check enabled branch, set `db.feature_flags.updateOne({key:'lf1_tone_check'}, {$set:{enabled:true}}, {upsert:true})` first. LLM latency: each Claude Sonnet 4.5 generate call is ~15-25s on the preview URL, so allocate 60s timeouts. All 6 archetype intake forms carry the exact testids called out in the spec — no drift.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only cosmetic polish items (missing data-testid on tone-check-disabled message, DialogDescription accessibility warning).
